subject: Re: Exchange plan for trial probe kit — usage ledger & takedown
messages:
From: Alice Moran <alice.moran@brightforge.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightForge Legal <legal@brightforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Trial probe kit exchange + usage constraints (MAP input)

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. BrightForge would like to proceed with a short, controlled exchange of evaluation assets so we can complete integration testing and run our acceptance set. High level asks: 1) temporary access to Redwood's probe kit (sample prompt pack + 500 labelled test cases) for 8 weeks; 2) mutual action plan with milestone dates and clear takedown/destruction obligations; 3) a usage ledger (log) and proof of deletion at the end of the term.

Key constraints from our security/compliance team:
- Assets cannot be redistributed outside our Redwood sandbox.
- No long-term retention beyond 90 days post-acceptance unless agreed.
- Only named engineers (I’ll list below) can access the raw testcases.

Can you circulate a MAP with the proposed dates and a short license stub? We can copy legal, but we want to move fast.

Regards,
Alice Moran
Head of Platform Integrations
BrightForge

---

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alice Moran <alice.moran@brightforge.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, legal-team@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial probe kit exchange + usage constraints (MAP input)

Alice —

Appreciate the clear list. We can do the exchange under a short MAP + an ephemeral license that binds both sides. Proposed draft timeline:

- Week 0 (Mon Apr 5): MAP kickoff + NDAs and sign-off on named users
- Week 1 (Mon Apr 12): Redwood provides probe kit bundle (prompt pack + 500 testcases) via secured Drive share; ephemeral credentials TTL = 56 days
- Weeks 2–6: BrightForge runs acceptance tests; weekly sync (30m) to surface regressions
- Week 7 (Mon May 24): Acceptance review; if passed, either sign extension or confirm destruction
- Week 9 (Mon Jun 7): Mandatory takedown + certified deletion evidence delivered to both parties

Usage rules we propose to add into the MAP: no external redistribution; ephemeral access only; allowed processing for evaluation and model tuning with clear audit logs; no commercial deployment of Redwood-generated variants of the testcases.

I’ve attached a MAP draft and the acceptance testcases CSV. I’ll loop in Product Security (cc’d) for a quick technical validation. If that looks right to you, can you confirm named users and that BrightForge legal will accept the proof-of-deletion clause?

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP-draft-BF-Redwood-20270402.pdf (draft MAP), acceptance-testcases.csv (sample cases)

---

On Fri, 02 Apr 2027 at 11:05 AM priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, product-security@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial probe kit exchange + usage constraints (MAP input)

All — quick note from Security: we are comfortable with ephemeral access and the deletion proof but need the following technical controls added to the MAP:
- Access via scoped service account with time-limited tokens (no password shares)
- Read-only S3/Drive access; no download of raw CSVs unless within our guarded sandbox environment
- Retention TTL for logs = 120 days (Redwood retains audit logs for troubleshooting only)

Also recommend an acceptance criteria appendix: 20 passing cases from the 500 sample set, and a regression limit no higher than 3% on the oracle baseline. I’ll add this into the MAP draft and return by Monday.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Platform Security | Redwood Inference

---

From: Alice Moran <alice.moran@brightforge.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightForge Legal <legal@brightforge.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial probe kit exchange + usage constraints (MAP input)

Sergio/Priyom —

This looks good and aligned with our security needs. Confirming named users: me (alice.moran@brightforge.ai), Jason Li (jason.li@brightforge.ai), and Maya Patel (m.patel@brightforge.ai). BrightForge legal is ok with the certified deletion clause provided Redwood's deletion proof includes (a) checksum of deleted files, (b) timestampped audit log entries, and (c) confirmation from Redwood's engineer.

We will sign the MAP draft doc and return it via DocuSign by Monday. Can Redwood provide the scoped service account details and the Drive share link once signed? Also please confirm whether the probe kit includes a small synthetic subset we can use in public demos (non-sensitive, fully synthetic).

Thanks —
Alice

---

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alice Moran <alice.moran@brightforge.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, product-security@redwood.ai, legal-team@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial probe kit exchange + usage constraints (MAP input)

Great — thanks for the named users. Next steps:
1) I’ll update the MAP with Priyom’s appendix (acceptance criteria + token rules) and push a DocuSign envelope by Monday morning.
2) On signature, we will provision the scoped service account and send the secure Drive link (probekit bundle + synthetic demo subset) with TTL = 56 days.
3) Redwood engineer will deliver deletion proof within 72 hours of takedown (checksum + timestamped log + engineer attestation).

I’ve attached the initial probekit bundle for preliminary review (attachments above). If anything else is required from BrightForge legal ahead of DocuSign, let us know.

Best,
Sergio

---

Thread notes: attachments referenced above are stubs (brightforge_probekit_v1.zip — contains prompt-pack/ and cases/; MAP-draft-BF-Redwood-20270402.pdf — draft MAP with milestones; acceptance-testcases.csv — sample ids 1001–1500).
